cases.title: Project creation options open their corresponding project flows
steps: Click "eRFX Project Manage sourcing via a project approach".
Confirm that the project creation screen opens.
Click "BOQ based RFX Project Source BOQ via a project approach".
cases.expected: The eRFX option opens the project creation screen. The BOQ option opens the BOQ-based project creation flow.
gaps: The catalog cannot definitively assert that the second creation screen is the BOQ-specific flow rather than another generic create screen; no BOQ-specific navigation assertion or screen step is available.

cases.title: Event list tabs switch the displayed event set
cases.expected: Each clicked tab becomes selected and its corresponding event list view is displayed. "Live 8583" is selected again at the end.
gaps: Exact selected state of each tab, including the numeric labels History 2035, Drafts 183, and Live 8583
That each tab displays its corresponding event set or exact event count

cases.title: Search Title filters the event list
steps: Enter a distinctive part of the identified event title.
Wait for the list to refresh.
cases.expected: The list shows matching event titles and excludes events that do not match the entered text.
cases.setup: Open /orders with "Live 8583" selected and identify a visible event title.
gaps: The distinctive part of the identified event title to enter was not provided.
A concrete nonmatching event title or list-wide assertion that every nonmatching event is excluded cannot be expressed with the available catalog steps.
